audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with lion/lamb throne imagery; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for sealed scroll, lion/lamb reversal, new song, priestly reign, universal worship.

verses.restored: And I saw upon the right hand of the One sitting upon the throne a scroll written within and on back, sealed with seven seals.

familiar.text: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

verses.restored: And I saw a strong messenger proclaiming with great voice: Who is worthy to open the scroll and loose its seals?

familiar.text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

verses.restored: And no one in heaven nor upon earth nor under earth was able to open the scroll nor to look into it.

familiar.text: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.restored: And I wept much because no one worthy was found to open the scroll nor to look into it.

familiar.text: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.restored: And one of elders says to me: Do not weep. Look, the Lion from tribe of Judah, the Root of David, conquered, to open the scroll and its seven seals.

familiar.text: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

verses.restored: And I saw in midst of throne and four living creatures and in midst of elders a Lamb standing as having been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of the Divine sent into all earth.

familiar.text: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

verses.restored: And he came and took from the right hand of the One sitting upon throne.

familiar.text: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

verses.restored: And when he took the scroll, the four living creatures and twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each having harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are prayers of holy ones.

familiar.text: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

verses.restored: And they sing new song, saying: Worthy are you to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were slain and by your blood/life purchased for the Divine from every tribe and tongue and people and nation,

familiar.text: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

verses.restored: and made them to our Divine a reign and priests, and they will reign upon earth.

familiar.text: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

verses.restored: And I saw and heard voice of many messengers around throne and living creatures and elders, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,

familiar.text: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

verses.restored: saying with great voice: Worthy is the Lamb who was slain to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

familiar.text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

verses.restored: And every creature in heaven and upon earth and under earth and upon sea, and all things in them, I heard saying: To the One sitting upon throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might into the ages of ages.

familiar.text: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

verses.restored: And the four living creatures said, Amen, and the elders fell and worshiped.

familiar.text: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

translation_notes: Lion is revealed as slain-standing Lamb: Revelation's central power-reversal.
Blood/life purchases a multi-people priestly reign; no ethnic erasure.
The prayers of holy ones appear as incense before the seals open.
safety_note: The Lamb conquers through faithful self-giving witness, not domination. This should govern the book's later images.
